jobs.occupation: Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Senior Expert Corporate M&A EMEA (f/m/d) to join our Internal Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche) division starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You will support strategy and acquisition / carve-out projects for PwC across EMEA. In doing so, you will identify growth opportunities, conduct market and sector analyses, and contribute to market sizing, competitive benchmarking, portfolio reviews, and commercial due diligences. Advisory - You will support senior team members in translating complex data into strategic recommendations that help shape PwC’s market position, profitability, and return on investment. You will also build your internal and external network across PwC, its advisors, and other professional services firms.  Transformation - You will contribute to deal pipelines and value creation plans in integration and carve-out projects, supporting a smooth transition from strategy to execution. This includes close collaboration with business units, internal functions such as Finance, and internal and external advisors across the deal lifecycle.Your profile- You have completed or are about to complete your studies in Business Administration, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering or Natural Sciences with a business-related focus.- You have gained more than three years of professional experience in Strategy Consulting, Private Equity, Corporate Development or In-house M&A and have worked across different stages of the deal lifecycle.- Experience in portfolio reviews, market assessments, commercial due diligence, transformation initiatives and value creation projects enables you to develop robust analyses and support strategic decision-making in a dynamic environment.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written. The team language is English.- You enjoy working in diverse international teams, navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring the flexibility to travel occasionally across the EMEA region when projects require it.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and  divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website. At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society.  In our Business Services we cover internal topics such as HR, Marketing, Finance, Middle Office, IT or our internal legal advice. Drive the development of PwC Germany in our various teams and use your expertise to strengthen our position as a potential employer. We offer you an exciting working environment where you can contribute your ideas and skills. ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Marketing Manager Global Campaigns (Fachwirt/in - Marketing/Bachelor Professional in Marketing)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHIn your role, you will shape the global campaign framework of ENERCON's solutions portfolio - from wind turbines and service offerings to our extended range of solutions, such as industrial power solutions. Together with your colleagues in the Global Communications and Marketing team, you will develop the overall campaign direction in close collaboration with Product and Solutions Management and Sales.We are looking for a new colleague to join us as soon as possible.This position is aligned within the Core Job PR & Marketing Manager III and salary group 6.Marketing Manager Global Campaigns (m/f/d)Your responsibilities:- You'll bring ENERCON's solutions portfolio to market through integrated B2B marketing campaigns, taking each campaign from the first strategic idea through planning and hands-on delivery to reviewing results and refining the approach.- Every campaign starts with a clear sense of who we want to reach and what we want to say. You'll turn target audiences, positioning and key messages into scalable global campaign frameworks, using a thoughtful customer journey and a clear content and channel architecture to give every activity its place.- From there, you'll bring the campaign to life across channels, steering the development and delivery of the right assets - from content and digital activities to event, presentation and sales enablement materials.- Making it happen is a shared effort. Working closely with Product and Solutions Management, Sales, and other internal and external partners, you'll keep campaign projects moving across functions, markets and regions. You'll also support your colleagues in Corporate Communications and Global Marketing on overarching corporate campaigns when needed.- The journey doesn't end with the first response. Your campaigns will attract qualified leads and nurture their interest, with lead nurturing processes and a handover to Sales that you'll shape and improve in close collaboration with the sales team.- A global idea needs to connect locally. You'll equip regional Marketing and Communications teams to adapt campaigns to their markets, while giving Sales relevant messages, materials and ideas to engage customers.- What works well should make the next campaign stronger. By turning proven approaches into campaign standards, reusable building blocks and clear processes, you'll help our campaigns scale globally, make better use of automation and run more efficiently.Your profile:- B2B marketing and campaign management are familiar territory: you bring several years of experience, ideally gained in an international industrial, technology or energy business.- Behind a complex solution or technology, you can find the story that matters to customers. You combine a sound understanding of products and solutions with a feel for customer needs, turning that knowledge into clear messages and campaign approaches that support Sales.- For you, a campaign is more than a collection of activities. It's about connecting audiences, messaging, content, channels and timing, right through to sales enablement - always with customer needs, sales relevance and measurable results in mind.- You communicate clearly and reliably, write with precision and a strong sense of your audience, and work confidently across functions, regions and organisational levels.- Good ideas make you want to get started. You enjoy turning them into action, working independently with structure, pragmatism and a hands-on mindset.- Marketing automation is a practical part of your craft. From campaign set-up and lead nurturing to email marketing and performance reporting, you know how the pieces fit together.- Paid social is familiar ground, too. You have experience with LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram and work confidently with audiences, ad formats, budgets and performance metrics.- Curiosity keeps you looking for better ways to work. You see the potential in new tools for automation, personalisation, content production and campaign management, and bring your own ideas to the conversation.- Excellent written and spoken German (C1/C2) is essential for this role, as many of our campaigns and their content are developed and delivered in German. Very good written and spoken English is equally important for the international roll-out of campaigns and for working confidently across our international organisation.
